summary: Personalis, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services expanded Medicare coverage for its NeXT Personal test to include monitoring treatment response to neoadjuvant therapy in Stage II-III Triple-Negative Breast Cancer or HER2+ breast cancer patients. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, advisors, or structural changes are mentioned. The filing simply discloses a regulatory coverage expansion, which does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activism, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
